messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: capacity_alert: queue_length > 95% for service 'inference-hotpath' across us-west-2. autoscaler lagging. Suggested action: page oncall.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired to team 'oncall-sre' (high). Incident link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD12345
SARA NGUYEN: acked on PD, coming in. pulling logs now. :running:
MIKE REED: seeing surge from a customer job pattern - lots of long sequences + small batch windows. queue depth = 142k, inflight per-worker saturated.
ANIKA PATEL: autoscaler metrics show scale_decision_latency ~= 3m (should be <30s). controller logs: `scale loop missed 4 cycles`
JULES K: copying in ops-bot for temporary capacity bump. ops-bot: `runbook/autoscaler -> manual_scale` available.
SARA NGUYEN: rolling manual scale up 6 nodes to the dedicated pool (small GPUs) to buy time. running: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment inference-hotpath --replicas=28`
MIKE REED: applying a short-lived rate cap on new inference API keys to reduce queue inflow. pushing feature-flag: `ff.inference.global_rate_limit = 0.75`
ANIKA PATEL: can we evict low-priority batch jobs? I see 12 long-running non-critical pods.
JULES K: permission granted. `kubectl delete pod -l job=batch-lowprio -n workloads` (doing staged deletes)
incident-bot: NOTE: Page escalation in 8m if not acknowledged by senior oncall.
SARA NGUYEN: logs: `kvcache miss ratio increased from 2% -> 48%` — likely thrash after scale attempts. investigating KV cache population.
MIKE REED: suggestion: temporarily disable small-batch aggregation to avoid overly long KV builds? or reduce max_context on cheap models.
ANIKA PATEL: starting quick patch: adjust batching window from 20ms -> 5ms to favor latency; may increase cost but reduces queue. patch: `service/batching: window_ms: 5`
ops-bot: manual scale completed. +6 nodes added to pool 'dedicated-small-gpu'. Confirm capacity: nodes=28, free_slots=42
SARA NGUYEN: queue falling slowly: 142k -> 98k in 6m. still high but trending.
pagerduty: Note: Incident annotated: customer impact suspected for requests >1s p50 on inference endpoints.
JULES K: important: route traffic for tier=free to fallback model 'redwood-small-ffn' to reduce heavy compute footprint. toggling route: `routing.policy.set('tier==free', model='redwood-small-ffn')`
MIKE REED: patch applied. approx 12% of inflow rerouted. immediate effect on cpu/gpu pressure.
ANIKA PATEL: autoscaler controller diagnostics: memory leak in scale decision goroutine causing backlog in reconcile queue. creating ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7842
SARA NGUYEN: will keep monitoring for 20m then escalate to SRE lead if cycle not recovered. handing off to night oncall at 00:30 UTC.
incident-bot: REMINDER: oncall escalation will fire if queue > 80k after 20m.
JULES K: prepping a short customer-facing note if we need to declare degraded performance. draft: "We're seeing elevated inference latency for some customers due to a capacity surge; we're actively scaling and mitigating. No data loss. Will provide updates every 30m."
MIKE REED: observed 10 503s from rate-limiter rule; investigations show they are from old SDK versions. adding temporary client-side guidance to reduce retry storms.
SARA NGUYEN: current status: queue=45k, p95 latency back to baseline for routed traffic, autoscaler still lagging but manual scale + routing stabilized pressure.
ANIKA PATEL: added hotfix to autoscaler to reset reconcile queue after panic and improved backoff. will push to canary cluster and watch.
ops-bot: hotfix deployed to canary cluster: `autoscaler:v2.4.1-hotfix`
incident-bot: ACTION: If any escalation needed, tag @jules k and @sara nguyen.
SARA NGUYEN: handing to night oncall - @mike reed will be backup overnight. leaving notes in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
MIKE REED: ack handoff. I'll monitor scaling loops, queue, and customer errors. please DM if anything flares.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by sara nguyen. escalation suppressed.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED? No — condition cleared: queue < 50k and p95 latency stable for 10m. Recommend post-incident RCA.
JULES K: filing postmortem and linking traces + k8s reconcile dumps. ETA for RCA draft: 48h.
SARA NGUYEN: leaving final note: root cause: autoscaler reconcile backlog + a spike in long-sequence requests. Mitigations applied: manual scale, routing fallbacks, batching window adjustment, eviction of low-priority jobs, hotfix to autoscaler.
MIKE REED: thumbs up. good teamwork. :thumbsup:
